evidence.detail: List of archetype sorters and their activity — basic dashboard created at /admin/sorters/ showing name, num_decks_sorted, sorted_per_day (all-time), last_sorted
Template shows Username, # Decks, Avg (all-time), Last — no revoke button, no differentiation of revoked users
load_sorters() SQL computes all-time sorted_per_day (MAX-MIN date range), not a rolling 30/90-day window; no join with permissions table to filter active sorters
Search returned no results — no revoke-permission endpoint exists for the sorters dashboard

triage.notes: Three outstanding sub-items: (1) revoke-permission button missing from template and no endpoint for it; (2) revoked users not distinguished (no permission-table join); (3) sorted_per_day is all-time average, not 30/90-day rolling. The 'people with no sorts appearing' sub-item appears fixed by the existing INNER JOIN in load_sorters().
